_note: Nametags over other runners and bots, and how their map pins treat another level (ui/markers.rs). height_m is above the feet; the tag is full strength up to fade_start_m, fades out by fade_end_m and is gone past it. font_size is in design units. screen_margin is the fraction of the screen a tag may sit past the edge before it is left out. Pins on another level are left off the minimap and dimmed on the full map (Godot facility_map.gd draws only the marks of the shown floor).
